## Reproducing the PECAN optimization session

1. Fill in `config.ini` with your `WORKSPACE_ROOT` and Flux allocation id.
2. Run `scripts/install.sh` to rebuild dependencies and the annotated PECAN source.
3. Run `scripts/run_all.sh <alloc-id>` to execute baseline5, the intermediate optimization runs, and final_all_opt in sequence.
4. Compare the reported epoch-2 wall times against baseline5 (31.54s) and final_all_opt (27.90s) — expect roughly -11.5% within noise.
